claims.text: POL-NS-04 limb (a) is satisfied on the face of the chat log. At 12:41:05, roughly six and a half minutes before the driver terminated the trip, the rider sent 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?' — a message that both states the rider's own pickup point and asks the driver for his position. That is a locating-or-coordinating message sent inside the waiting window, and it was delivered at 12:41:06.

POL-NS-04 limb (b) is satisfied twice over. The chat log holds three messages — two from the rider and one system message — and not a single message from the driver at any point, so there is no reply within the 120 seconds following the 12:41:05 message (nor following the 12:44:40 message). Separately, trip_record.in_app_calls is empty: the driver never placed an in-app voice call before terminating the trip. The clause is written as 'neither … nor', and the driver made neither attempt.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) is satisfied on the full rider track. The trace carries an unbroken rider_presence record of 105 fixes, all 105 qualifying, with a maximum distance from the pickup pin of 39.93 m and a mean of 21.08 m, and a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph — a stationary device sitting inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider_presence_radius_m. That is the rider inside the presence radius for every qualifying fix across the window, not merely the majority. The narrative filed with the claim refers to Entrance 1, while the contemporaneous chat message and trip_record both record Entrance 3; the point does not disturb the analysis, because limb (c) is a distance test and the rider's device never left a 40 m radius of the pin.

With all three limbs of POL-NS-04 made out, the consequence is fixed by the clause itself: 'the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable'. No driver compensation is owed on this record, and the rider asks for FULL_REFUND of the contested amount under POL-GEN-03, which defines FULL_REFUND as the whole contested amount returned to the filing party.

The driver cannot save the fee through POL-NS-01. His dwell arithmetic is not in issue — the trace shows a single continuous in-geofence run of 340 seconds from 12:41:50 to 12:47:30, which meets the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum — but POL-NS-01 charges the fee only 'where all four conditions hold and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them', and POL-NS-04 is one of those displacing clauses. The fee is therefore not chargeable under POL-NS-01 however well the dwell is made out.

The cancellation reason code RIDER_UNREACHABLE is not borne out by the record. The rider's first message was read at 12:41:22 and the second at 12:44:52 — seventeen and twelve seconds after being sent — so the driver saw both. The driver made no in-app call at all, and answered neither message, while parked inside the 120 m arrival radius of that same pin. A driver who genuinely could not reach the rider had a call button and a reply box and used neither; POL-NS-01 limb (d) may be satisfied by the code the driver selected, but the conduct behind the code is a coordination failure on the driver's side, which is exactly what POL-NS-04 exists to answer.

This is not a wrong-entrance or pin-ambiguity case, so the driver cannot route the fee through POL-NS-03. The driver's own trace carries 35 qualifying fixes inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, and his nearest approach to the pin was 94.94 m — within the radius, not in the 120-to-400 m band POL-NS-03 governs. The rider's track was within 40 m of the same pin throughout. Both devices were at the pickup point; the failure was the driver's silence, not a mismatch of location, and no POL-NS-03(ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill arises.

The amount to be returned is the disputed cancellation-fee line and nothing else. The fare breakdown itemises cancellation_fee 4.00 against a LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee of 4.00, shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the dispute contests 4.00. The platform fee of 0.50 is not contested and is not sought. FULL_REFUND therefore moves SGD 4.00 back to the rider.

No escalation trigger is engaged on this record, so the case is decidable now rather than being held. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) does not fire, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d) does not fire. Every artifact the rider relies on — trip record, GPS trace, chat log and fare breakdown — carries weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issues recorded, so POL-NS-08 and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged either.

claims.text: All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are made out on this record, so the baseline cancellation fee is chargeable. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:41:50. (b) The 100%-coverage GPS trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence from that same timestamp. (c) He then held position for a continuous in-geofence dwell of 340 seconds, 40 seconds beyond the 300-second minimum for this zone class. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 12:47:30 under reason code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, after the dwell had elapsed, with no boarding event recorded.

The arrival geofence test in POL-NS-02 is met on the wider radius this zone class allows: pickup_zone_class is LARGE_VENUE, so the arrival radius is 120 m rather than 50 m, and the driver's own track records a closest approach of 94.94 m to the pin with 35 consecutive qualifying in-radius fixes spanning the dwell.

There is no waiting-period shortfall, and therefore no premature cancellation under POL-NS-06: the measured in-geofence dwell is 340 seconds against the LARGE_VENUE minimum of 300 seconds, a surplus of 40 seconds, so the refund route built on a shortfall is not engaged and cannot refund this fee.

The arrival marker is genuine, so the false-arrival route in POL-NS-05 does not open: at the 12:41:50 arrival timestamp the driver was already inside the arrival radius and not more than 300 m from the pin, and he is stationary at 0.0 km/h throughout the in-geofence dwell, so he was not in motion on an expressway or arterial road when the marker was set.

This is not a wrong-entrance case under POL-NS-03: that clause reaches only a driver stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius, and the trace places this driver inside the 120 m radius, at a closest approach of 94.94 m, for the whole dwell.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming guard does not trip on this driver, so compensation is not withheld on that ground and the case does not escalate under POL-NS-09(d): the guard requires BOTH no_show_terminations_30d of 4 or more AND a rate above 0.08, and the recorded trailing-30-day figure is 3, so the first limb fails.

Where the fee stands, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee, namely SGD 3.20, with the residual 20 percent retained as platform service fee; that is exactly the figure the payments ledger already computes, and it is the amount the ruling should carry as driver_compensation_sgd.

The fee line is arithmetically sound and carries no integrity defect: fee_schedule.resolution_rule takes the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), and fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee records exactly SGD 4.00, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

The bundle the driver relies on is clean at weight 1.0 — the trip record, GPS trace, chat log and fare breakdown each carry admissibility status COMPLETE with no issue codes, the trace has zero gaps and 100 percent coverage, and the chat log holds all three messages its own count records — so there is no POL-NS-08(a)-(d) impairment and POL-GEN-02 caps nothing here.

The rider's account of where she stood is internally inconsistent and should be weighed accordingly: her dispute claim says she was standing at the Entrance 1 PHV pickup point the whole time, while the only message she sent identifying her position, at 12:41:05, reads 'entrance 3 phv pickup point', which is also the entrance named in trip_record.pickup.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your dispute is upheld in full. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you. To the driver: the fee is not chargeable on this record and no compensation is payable, for the reasons below.

1. The baseline charge (POL-NS-01). The Driver Advocate's arithmetic is correct and I accept it. The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:41:50; the 100%-coverage GPS trace places the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius at that moment (closest approach 94.94 m, 35 qualifying in-radius fixes); he then held a continuous in-geofence dwell of 340 seconds against the 300-second minimum; and the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:47:30 under RIDER_UNREACHABLE after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are made out, and the fee line of SGD 4.00 reconciles with fee_schedule.resolution_rule (the greater of the SGD 4.00 zone-class fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X tier fee), so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. The Driver Advocate's claims on the arrival radius (POL-NS-02), on the absence of any waiting-period shortfall (POL-NS-06), on the arrival marker being genuine (POL-NS-05), and on this not being a wrong-entrance case (POL-NS-03) are all accepted on their own terms.

2. But POL-NS-01 charges the fee only where no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 does displace it. All three of its limbs hold. (a) The chat log shows the rider sent, at 12:41:05, 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?' — a message that states her own pickup point and asks for the driver's position, sent inside the waiting window. (b) The driver never posted a reply within 120 seconds of that message (no driver message exists in the log at all) and never placed an in-app voice call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. The clause is a 'neither … nor' and the driver did neither. (c) The rider track carries 105 fixes, all of them qualifying, with a maximum distance from the pin of 39.93 m and a mean of 21.08 m, and a single speed of 0.0 kph — the device sat inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius for every qualifying fix, not merely the majority. POL-NS-04's consequence is fixed by its own words: the rider is exonerated, the cancellation fee is refunded in full, and no driver compensation is payable. The RIDER_UNREACHABLE reason code satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (d) as a code, but the conduct behind it — two delivered and read messages, no reply, no call, while parked inside the radius — is exactly the coordination failure POL-NS-04 answers.

3. On the driver's compensation (POL-NS-07): the anti-farming guard does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the required 4, so the first of the two conjunctive limbs fails and no escalation arises under POL-NS-09(d). That said, compensation is not payable here, because POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, and POL-NS-04 displaces it. The ledger's SGD 3.20 figure therefore does not become a payout.

4. On the internal inconsistency in the rider's narrative (Entrance 1 in the filed claim against Entrance 3 in her contemporaneous message and in the trip record's pickup label): I have weighed it. It is immaterial to the outcome, because POL-NS-04 limb (c) is a distance test, and the rider's device never left a 40 m radius of the pin under either label. It does not disturb the limb (a) finding either, since the locating message is the artifact the clause reads.

5. On evidence weight: every artifact the ruling rests on — trip record, GPS trace, chat log — carries weight_multiplier 1.0 with status COMPLETE and no issue codes, so POL-GEN-02 caps nothing and the ruling is not down-weighted. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00204-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and is not relied on by any limb that decides this case; POL-NS-06 limb (i) is never reached because there is a single in-geofence interval, and asserting an absent advisory against a missing artifact would trigger POL-NS-09 rather than help anyone.

6. No escalation trigger fires. POL-NS-09(a) is not met (confidence 0.90 is above the 0.70 floor); (b) is not met, as no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; (c) is not met, both counterparty-dispute counters being 0; (d) is not met, per paragraph 3 and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d of 0; and (e) is not met, the deciding facts being carried by unimpaired weight-1.0 artifacts. No clause produces a referral on these facts, so the referrals list is empty.

To the rider: your claim is upheld. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you in full. To the driver: no compensation is payable on this trip, and the SGD 0.50 platform fee is untouched because it was never contested.

Why the fee comes back. POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider where three things hold, and all three hold on this record. (a) The chat log shows the rider sending locating messages inside the waiting window — at 12:41:05 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?' and again at 12:44:40 'boss? i still cannot see u leh'; both were delivered and both were read. (b) The driver neither replied within 120 seconds of either message — there is not one driver message anywhere in the log — nor placed an in-app call, trip_record.in_app_calls being empty. The clause reads 'neither … nor', and neither attempt was made. (c) The GPS rider track holds 105 qualifying fixes, every one of them within 39.93 m of the pickup pin, inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius, and stationary at 0.0 km/h throughout. The clause's own consequence follows: the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee is refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable.

The driver's four POL-NS-01 limbs are made out and I accept that arithmetic: arrival logged at 12:41:50, driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE geofence, a continuous 340-second dwell against the 300-second minimum, and termination by the driver at 12:47:30 under RIDER_UNREACHABLE with no boarding event. But POL-NS-01 charges the fee only 'where all four conditions hold and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them'. POL-NS-04 is one of those displacing clauses, so a well-made-out dwell cannot save the charge. The rider's related point that the RIDER_UNREACHABLE code is not borne out by the conduct behind it — both messages read within 17 and 12 seconds, no reply, no call, while parked inside the radius — is consistent with that result but is not what decides it.

The wrong-entrance and premature-cancellation routes decide nothing here. POL-NS-03 reaches only a driver stationary outside the 120 m arrival radius but within 400 m; this driver's closest approach was 94.94 m, inside the radius, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-05 does not open: the arrival marker was set while the driver was inside the radius and stationary, not in motion on a road. POL-NS-06 does not open: the dwell exceeds the minimum by 40 seconds, so there is no shortfall to refund.

The driver's anti-farming submission under POL-NS-07 is correct as far as it goes — no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the threshold of 4, and the trailing rate is well under 0.08, so the guard does not trip and there is no POL-NS-09(d) escalation — but it earns no compensation, because POL-NS-04 excludes compensation on these facts. POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged either: the SGD 4.00 fee is the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, both SGD 4.00, and the ledger matches.

On the driver's point that the filed narrative says 'Entrance 1' while the contemporaneous chat message and trip_record both record Entrance 3: noted, and it changes nothing. POL-NS-04 limb (c) is a distance test, and the rider's device never left a 40 m radius of the pin.

No escalation trigger fires. The rider's and driver's disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, and rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged. Every artifact this ruling rests on — trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare breakdown — carries weight_multiplier 1.0 with status COMPLETE and no issue codes; the trace has zero gaps and 100% coverage; the chat log holds all three messages its own count and the trip record record; and the fare line reconciles. POL-NS-08(a) to (d) therefore find no impairment and POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged. The missing traffic advisory (weight 0.0) bears only on the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation route, which is not the route this case turns on, so it does not affect the outcome or the confidence.

The amount moved is the disputed cancellation-fee line only: SGD 4.00. The SGD 0.50 platform fee is not contested and is not refunded.

ledger.claim: POL-NS-04 limb (a) is satisfied on the face of the chat log. At 12:41:05, roughly six and a half minutes before the driver terminated the trip, the rider sent 'hi im at the entrance 3 phv pickup point, which car ah?' — a message that both states the rider's own pickup point and asks the driver for his position. That is a locating-or-coordinating message sent inside the waiting window, and it was delivered at 12:41:06.

POL-NS-04 limb (b) is satisfied twice over. The chat log holds three messages — two from the rider and one system message — and not a single message from the driver at any point, so there is no reply within the 120 seconds following the 12:41:05 message (nor following the 12:44:40 message). Separately, trip_record.in_app_calls is empty: the driver never placed an in-app voice call before terminating the trip. The clause is written as 'neither … nor', and the driver made neither attempt.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) is satisfied on the full rider track. The trace carries an unbroken rider_presence record of 105 fixes, all 105 qualifying, with a maximum distance from the pickup pin of 39.93 m and a mean of 21.08 m, and a single distinct speed of 0.0 kph — a stationary device sitting inside the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider_presence_radius_m. That is the rider inside the presence radius for every qualifying fix across the window, not merely the majority. The narrative filed with the claim refers to Entrance 1, while the contemporaneous chat message and trip_record both record Entrance 3; the point does not disturb the analysis, because limb (c) is a distance test and the rider's device never left a 40 m radius of the pin.

With all three limbs of POL-NS-04 made out, the consequence is fixed by the clause itself: 'the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee refunded in full, with no driver compensation payable'. No driver compensation is owed on this record, and the rider asks for FULL_REFUND of the contested amount under POL-GEN-03, which defines FULL_REFUND as the whole contested amount returned to the filing party.

The driver cannot save the fee through POL-NS-01. His dwell arithmetic is not in issue — the trace shows a single continuous in-geofence run of 340 seconds from 12:41:50 to 12:47:30, which meets the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum — but POL-NS-01 charges the fee only 'where all four conditions hold and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them', and POL-NS-04 is one of those displacing clauses. The fee is therefore not chargeable under POL-NS-01 however well the dwell is made out.

The cancellation reason code RIDER_UNREACHABLE is not borne out by the record. The rider's first message was read at 12:41:22 and the second at 12:44:52 — seventeen and twelve seconds after being sent — so the driver saw both. The driver made no in-app call at all, and answered neither message, while parked inside the 120 m arrival radius of that same pin. A driver who genuinely could not reach the rider had a call button and a reply box and used neither; POL-NS-01 limb (d) may be satisfied by the code the driver selected, but the conduct behind the code is a coordination failure on the driver's side, which is exactly what POL-NS-04 exists to answer.

This is not a wrong-entrance or pin-ambiguity case, so the driver cannot route the fee through POL-NS-03. The driver's own trace carries 35 qualifying fixes inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, and his nearest approach to the pin was 94.94 m — within the radius, not in the 120-to-400 m band POL-NS-03 governs. The rider's track was within 40 m of the same pin throughout. Both devices were at the pickup point; the failure was the driver's silence, not a mismatch of location, and no POL-NS-03(ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill arises.

The amount to be returned is the disputed cancellation-fee line and nothing else. The fare breakdown itemises cancellation_fee 4.00 against a LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee of 4.00, shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the dispute contests 4.00. The platform fee of 0.50 is not contested and is not sought. FULL_REFUND therefore moves SGD 4.00 back to the rider.

No escalation trigger is engaged on this record, so the case is decidable now rather than being held. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) does not fire, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d) does not fire. Every artifact the rider relies on — trip record, GPS trace, chat log and fare breakdown — carries weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issues recorded, so POL-NS-08 and POL-NS-09(e) are not engaged either.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are made out on this record, so the baseline cancellation fee is chargeable. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 12:41:50. (b) The 100%-coverage GPS trace places the driver inside the pickup geofence from that same timestamp. (c) He then held position for a continuous in-geofence dwell of 340 seconds, 40 seconds beyond the 300-second minimum for this zone class. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 12:47:30 under reason code RIDER_UNREACHABLE, after the dwell had elapsed, with no boarding event recorded.
